page.layout: One printed page. Two parallel verse columns at top (left and right), then full-width running text below with a heading in capitals, then a closing line at the bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Offertorium: Protege, Domine, plebem tu-um, per signum sanctæ tuæ crucis, ab omni-bus infidiis inimicorum omnium, ut tibi grata exhibeamus servitutem, & acceptabile fiat sacrificium nostrum.
Post communionem: Domine, quos sanctæ crucis lætari fecisti honore, ejus quoq; per-petuis defende subsidiis.
main_text.head: AD S. CRUCEM, CORONAM spineam, sudarium, clavos, & lanceam.
main_text.p: Adoramus, in nomine tuo, Christe, tuæ victoriosæ crucis vexillum, tuum diadema spineum, tuum sanctum linteum, tuos ru-bentes sanguine clavos, ac tuo sacro lateri immersam lanceam.

page.notes: Verse columns are set in italic in the original; the left column ends with the line "Inscriptuvis, sub figuris" as printed. Some letters are worn and uncertain, notably in the first lines and the heading. The page ends with a catchword-like word "Ave" at the lower right, given as signature.
